items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy and Charlie came in about 1947, and I didn't have anything to do with it then, didn't know them.

ctx.x: What was the relationship in New York between, say, yourself and Charlie Parker and Dizzy?

Well, I didn't know Charlie. And Dizzy came just after -- Dizzy and Charlie came in about 1947, and I didn't have anything to do with it then, didn't know them. But the other musicians that were getting plaudits, you didn't see them playing with us as much or anymore.
